vuln_statements.explanation: Based on the vulnerability root cause, the mlx5e_reset_txqsq_cc_pc() function incorrectly resets the DMA FIFO consumer counter (dma_fifo_cc) to zero without simultaneously resetting the producer counter (dma_fifo_pc). This single statement causes desynchronization between producer and consumer counters during Send Queue error recovery, as the fix intent would require both counters to be reset together.
